caption:
You use around 136 litres of water a day 💧
That's the average per person in England (UK government, 2024–25). Yet in one Water UK survey, 46% guessed their whole household uses under 20.
Power shower: about 13 L a minute · Bath: about 80 L · Flush: 5–9 L · Washing machine: about 50 L

How many litres do you think you use? Comment your guess 👇
Sources: GOV.UK, Water UK
